title: {name} and the Red Kite
outfit: a mustard-yellow sweater with a small red kite on the chest, blue trousers and red sneakers

scenes.scene: {name} wakes up in a cosy bedroom at sunrise, sitting up in bed and stretching with a big sleepy smile. Seen from the waist up, face large and clearly visible.
scenes.text: Every morning, {name} woke up with the sun. But today was special. Today was kite day!

scenes.tests: full body in motion, outfit consistency
scenes.scene: {name} runs across a green park in Tashkent in autumn, full body, mid-stride, holding the string of a bright red kite flying high in the sky. Golden plane trees around.
scenes.text: Up, up went the red kite, higher than the trees, higher than the birds.

scenes.tests: a second character without the hero changing
scenes.scene: {name} sits on a park bench next to a kind grandmother in a colourful headscarf. They share a round loaf of Uzbek bread and look up at the red kite caught in the branches of a tall plane tree. Both full body, medium shot.
scenes.text: - Don't worry, - said Grandma. - Kites are like birds. Sometimes they need to rest.

scenes.tests: likeness under different lighting and angle
scenes.scene: Night. {name} lies on the bedroom floor in pyjamas, drawing a new kite with crayons by the warm light of a small lamp. Stars and a crescent moon in the window. Seen from slightly above.
scenes.text: That night, {name} drew a brand new kite. This one would fly even higher.
